const colorClasses = { blue: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200', emerald: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200', purple: 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200', orange: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200' }; const jobStatusColors = { active: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700', urgent: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700', closed: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700' }; return (
